experiences.name: Sagrada Família Guided Tour
experiences.description: Explore Gaudí's iconic unfinished basilica with a skip-the-line guided tour. Marvel at the intricate facades, stunning stained glass, and towering spires that define Barcelona's skyline. Opt for tower access for panoramic city views.

experiences.name: Gothic Quarter & El Born Walking Tour
experiences.description: Wander through Barcelona's medieval Gothic Quarter, discovering Roman ruins, the Barcelona Cathedral, and hidden plazas. Continue into the trendy El Born neighborhood filled with modernist buildings, boutiques, and street art.

experiences.name: Park Güell & Gràcia Neighborhood Exploration
experiences.description: Visit Gaudí's whimsical Park Güell with its mosaic terraces and dragon staircase, then descend into the bohemian Gràcia neighborhood to explore its charming squares, local tapas bars, and vibrant street life.

experiences.name: La Boqueria Market & Tapas Crawl
experiences.description: Start at the legendary La Boqueria market to sample fresh local produce, jamón, and pintxos. Then embark on a self-guided tapas crawl through El Raval and the Gothic Quarter, tasting patatas bravas, croquetas, and pan con tomate at traditional bodegas.

experiences.name: Barceloneta Beach Sunset & Nightlife on Passeig Marítim
experiences.description: Relax on Barceloneta Beach at golden hour, then transition into Barcelona's legendary nightlife scene. Enjoy cocktails at rooftop beach bars, dance at open-air clubs along the Passeig Marítim, and experience the city's world-famous after-midnight club culture.
